rows.title: Highlight
notes: “What do we have before? Sade was Rufus and Chaka Khan from an album... called Camouflage from 1981... That was a live album with Ain't Nobody Thrown In for Good Luck. That tune was called Highlight”
Closing track on Rufus & Chaka Khan's 1981 MCA studio album Camouflage (it's actually a studio album, not live — presenter misspoke).

1994 UK garage/house track produced by Al Mack with vocalist Jacqueline, released in multiple mixes including this 'Santana Tribute Vibe' version (not related to Carlos Santana).
